investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Orberon Finance (digital banking); Platform: Google Cloud europe-west1 (zones europe-west1-b/europe-west1-c/europe-west1-d); network range 10.100.0.0/16; Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-02, maxmemory 16gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the limits-svc PostgreSQL database limits-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
